scope: Barrick Q1 and Q2 2026 gold operating statistics used to refresh the Team 4 production/cost layer only

separation_policy.gold_price_layer_owner: Team 8 current option-calibrated models under the unified conditional bridge

derived_files.note: Eight mines retained from the Team 4 production study; production and cost are Barrick-attributable where reported.
Company totals include operations outside the eight-mine analytical subset.

transformation_notes: Values were transcribed from Barrick's published quarterly mine-statistics tables without interpolation.
Percentages are stored as percentage points, not decimal fractions.
The unified 20-quarter operating contract replaces only 2026Q1 and 2026Q2 with current Barrick actuals; 2026Q3 onward remains the Team 4 forecast and is labelled as forecast.

Market and realized gold prices are retained only as contemporaneous source facts. The unified valuation uses the Q2 realized price as an independently sourced level anchor and never imports Team 4 simulated price paths.
